addons.title: Lush Friends
addons.notes: A small list of the friends you pick: their level, white while online, grey while offline. Give anyone a nickname.

addons.title: Lush KOS
addons.notes: A kill-on-sight list shared with your friends and guild. Right-click an enemy's portrait or type /lkos to add them; you get a sound, an alert and a skull on their nameplate when they're near.

addons.title: Lush Cat Energy
addons.notes: Druid power bars: your form's resource big on top, the others under it. Energy marks each ability's cost; Mana shows the five-second rule.
